device: iPhone 15, iOS 26.x (or the newest release), Home Screen app; floor device (Q-10): tier mobile-low at 30 fps; operator Preview built with the synth world (QA build)

steps.instruction: Build one Preview with the synth world and QA flags (Preview builds carry no world on their own, DL-653): pnpm map:build -- --area synth && DV_WORLD=synth VITE_DV_QA=1 pnpm build && pnpm deploy:preview. Write the Preview URL into notes.json as previewUrl.

In Safari open the Preview URL, then Share > Add to Home Screen, and launch the app from the Home Screen icon (not from Safari). Open <preview>/?perf=1&tier=mobile-low&scenario=walk-civic-center&debug=1. The HUD must show 'mobile-low  webgl2'. The sky controls show under the sim panel; they carry the look switch (look on, the default) and the active post-node list, which must read 'tonemap' on this tier.

In the sky controls set the hour to 21:30 and the weather to clear, tick Freeze, and let the walk-civic-center scenario run to its end with the look ON (the default). The streets must show the new look: vertex colours by day are not visible at this hour, so the lit windows (the window grid as the night emissive mask) and the street lamps must read, with tone mapping only. Tap Export and save perf.json and notes.json to docs/device-runs/M02e/iphone15/.

Untick the look switch in the debug panel (the M02b1/M02b2 materials return) and run walk-civic-center at 21:30 clear once more. Write both median frame times and their delta (look on minus look off, ms) into notes.json as lookCost: { offMedianMs, onMedianMs, deltaMs }. If the on median is over the 30 fps budget (33.3 ms), say so; the Architect's fallback for a slow mobile look is `shadowsOff` for mobile and the `min` profile, both data.

Run pnpm perf:verify -- docs/device-runs/M02e/iphone15/perf.json --tier mobile-low --checklist tools/ci/checklists/M02e-iphone15.json: the median and p95 frame times, the frames over 50 ms and the render and triangle counts must pass at mobile-low with the look on.
